_note: Manual v1 (2026-10-15) is the current Children's Toys, Arts, and Crafts Program Manual for Category 21. The house DOI suffix hmtc.manual.childrens-toys-arts-and-crafts is reserved for deposit. cert_doi stays empty until that deposit. Method edition is at /program/method.

versions.label: Manual v1
versions.summary: First Category 21 Program Manual. Twenty-one live standards. Numeric ceilings are the values on those standards. Species with no separate number are capped at the parent total and tested on every lot. Metal safety only.
